description: Server transport chokepoint pin (AGENTS.md — http-client.ts is the single source of truth for all API communication). Every file below still performs raw network egress (fetch / EventSource / WebSocket) instead of going through the transport facade at lib/http-client.ts, which re-exports the split transport in apps/lib/ (url, corr-id, interceptors, retry, verbs, streamSSE, authFetch). HAND-MAINTAINED: a generated baseline verifies nothing. Entries may only shrink — a new file doing raw egress must route through the transport, not be added here. Every entry MUST carry a matching allowListReasons entry, so a pinned file is always a documented decision rather than an oversight.

allowListReasons.app/(app)/calendar/page.tsx: Calls the web origin's own Next route (/api/calendar/*) — app to app, a different boundary from app to backend (API_SCOPES covers exactly planner|calendar). _resolveUrl already keeps it same-origin.
allowListReasons.app/(app)/consciousness/api-explorer/pag: The page exists to send arbitrary requests chosen by the operator; raw fetch is the feature (same clause as DevApiPlaygroundCard).
allowListReasons.app/(app)/consciousness/docs/page.tsx: No live egress remains: the only fetch( in the file sits inside a template literal — a copy-pasteable snippet rendered for readers. The scanner strips comments but not template literals, so the row must stay for set-equality to remain honest.
allowListReasons.features/chat/components/panels/useVisio: Local preview URLs (blob:/object URLs) for vision inference — not server communication.
allowListReasons.features/chat/hooks/useChatLocalEngine.t: Loads in-browser engine assets; compute path, not backend traffic.
allowListReasons.hooks/useV86.ts: Emulator ROM and disk image loading for v86 — compute path, not backend traffic.
allowListReasons.lib/dev-log.ts: Structural cycle: dev-log owns and registers the transport's logger port, so sending its own ingest through the transport would close a log -> transport -> log loop. It posts to PUBLIC_API_URL standalone, fire-and-forget, keepalive.
allowListReasons.lib/multimodal-controller.ts: data:/blob payloads consumed by local multimodal inference — not server communication.
allowListReasons.lib/planner-proxy.ts: Targets a separate service (PLANNER_API_BASE, default http://127.0.0.1:8787) with its own origin. Routing it through the app transport would attach the sloughGPT bearer token to a different process.
allowListReasons.lib/soulnet-webgpu/engine.ts: Model weight loading (remote weight URLs and raw buffers) — compute path, not backend traffic.
allowListReasons.lib/soulnet-webgpu/transformer-engine.ts: Model weight loading (remote weight URLs and raw buffers) — compute path, not backend traffic.
allowListReasons.lib/soulnet-webgpu/worker.ts: Model weight loading (remote weight URLs and raw buffers) inside the worker — compute path, not backend traffic.
